inputs.text: This ruling by the Punjab and Haryana High Court granting bail to an individual held under national security provisions and the Official Secrets Act is a reckless blow against our nation's security and sovereignty. The person maintained telephonic contact with a Karachi-based Punjabi Kuri in Pakistan, a connection that clearly signals risks to sensitive information instead of being brushed aside as harmless. These laws are meant to protect the country from external threats and uphold proper order, yet the courts appear more eager to loosen vital controls than to defend our borders and traditional way of life. Such decisions only encourage greater danger from across the border, erode the authority required for social stability, and put personal claims ahead of our collective duty to safeguard the homeland. We must reject this softening of standards that undermines national strength.
